gaps: P0: nothing; P6: only annotated panoramas (labels and pointer lines drawn across the skyline) and a mall roof, skipped
notes: Kept the 1663 Ottendorf drawing for P2 (Bouttats 1686 and Bodenehr 1716 are good engravings but not clearly better than a colored view). The 1552 miniature is folio 18b of the same manuscript as the double page dated 1557–58 (#1), so dated 1558; it is a stylized Ottoman depiction, marked as an event. The 1809 view is crude and small but clearly labeled and matches the fortress town of the time. The postcard is dated between about 1905 and 1918 (Hungarian caption).
